abstract fun [generateContent](generate-content.html)(request: [LlmRequest](../-llm-request/index.html), stream: [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html) = false): Flow<[LlmResponse](../-llm-response/index.html)>
